Name: Abigail Portrait - CosyAnjalea Style - WIP
Author: CosyAnjalea
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]So, I've always wanted to make some sorta portrait mod, and portraiture makes it very easy for me to do so. So here's the Abigail portrait.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download zip.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Unzip into stardew valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Run game, and press the P key, or whatever you set the hotkey as.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It's to simply change the character's portrait.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Required mods: Portraiture/PortraiturePlus[/color][/size]
